title: Power BI and Tableau Cloud connectors for BI imports (Public Preview)
body: You can now connect Genie Code to Power BI and Tableau Cloud with Databricks-provided MCP connectors. When you import a report with `/importBI`, Genie Code checks the result against the live source to improve migration quality. This feature is in Public Preview. See [Connect to your BI tool to improve migration quality](/aws/en/dashboards/manage/import-bi#bi-mcp).
